package main

import (
	"os"
	"github.com/urfave/cli/v2"
)

func main() {
	app := &cli.App{
		Flags: []cli.Flag{
			&cli.StringFlag{Name: "config", Aliases: []string{"conf"}, Usage: "config"},
			&cli.BoolFlag{Name: "debug", Hidden: true},
			&cli.IntFlag{Name: "ttl"},
		},
	}
	_ = app.Run(os.Args)
}
